'''Blessed Toxmalb''' was one of the oldest members<ref name="TUR" /> of the entropy worshiping organization known as the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Only power is real, and the only real power is the power to destroy. Existence is fleeting. Destruction is eternal.|The core tenets of the Sorcerers of Rhand|<ref>{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/04/endnotes-for-star-wars-unknown-regions.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Unknown Regions|date=2010-04-19}}</ref>}}
Blessed Toxmalb was a member of the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]]. Residing in the [[Perann Nebula/Legends|Perann Nebula]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], the Sorcerers were a group of beings who believed in a power greater than [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] which they called [[Way of the Dark|the Dark]]. By following the Will or the Way of the Dark, they were granted special [[Force power/Legends|powers]]. Toxmalb was one of the oldest members of this order, and due to over a century of [[darksight]] path-walking, he obtained the position of [[Rhandite Lorekeeper]].

Toxmalb lived in the crumbling aerie of the [[High Tower Observatory]] of [[Rhand]]´s central ruin. Spending his time storing treasures for safekeeping and translation, he was also known for sometimes guiding visitors on the twelve worlds of the Nihil Retreat.

==Personality and traits==
Blessed Toxmalb was considered to be a repulsive being by most sentients; his body had been so destroyed by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] that his skin was nothing but powdery dry flakes which fell away from his body in rivulets, while his eyes were simply sunken holes. He was noted for being tall, and though he was bipedal, his [[Species/Legends|species]] was unknown.

Toxmalb was a master of numerous languages, especially those of the Unknown Regions, able to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Anzat (language)|Anzat]], [[Cheunh/Legends|Cheunh]], [[Drommnyr]], [[Ebruchese]], [[Killik (language)|Killik]], [[Minnisiat/Legends|Minnisiat]], [[Sy Bisti/Legends|Sy Bisti]], [[Tof (language)|Tof]], [[Vagaari (language)|Vagaari]], among many others. His voice was a dry croaking sound.

He dressed in ragged, decaying robes and wore a [[Shadow Crown|shadow crown]] buried underneath his skin, allowing him to control up to one hundered [[Rhandites|Rhandite Pawns]], who dwelt across the [[Nihil Retreat]], at any given time.<ref name="TUR" />

==Powers and abilities==
Toxmalb was an extremely adept dark-sider and was able to call upon many aspects of the [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. In addition to simple [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] such as [[Force sense/Legends|Force sense]], [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]], and [[Farsight/Legends|farsight]], he was also a master of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force grip]], and [[Force Enrage|Force rage]]. The shadow crown buried into his skull allowed him to control and communicate with over a hundred different beings throughout the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the Nihil Retreat, who were known as "Pawns" and were fully in his thrall.

The [[Darkfly|darkflies]] that inhabited his head and flesh were subject to his whims, and at his direction would erupt from his body to attack his enemies. Though the flies could not bite, they would form a suffocating cloud that would choke his enemies to [[Death/Legends|death]].

He was also fully immune to any [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricks]].
